content.class.traveller.blurb: 你趁着晚潮沿海岸路走来，身上只有一盏提灯。
content.class.traveller.name: 旅人
content.containers.decoration_notice: 厅里的木桶都空着，已经空了好些年。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-after.opt.0.label: 它立着呢。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-after.text: 我听见钟响了。别跟我说那上头什么也没有。它立起来了？
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-bell.opt.0.label: 我去敲。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-bell.text: 钟就挂在栈桥尽头。敲一下，然后看那根石柱。我守了它三十个冬天，绳子一回都没碰过。你走过去，回来告诉我。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.0.label: 那边有什么？
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.1.label: 那口钟做什么用？
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.text: 晚上好。你是沿着海岸过来的，那湾里的石柱你该看见了。别在屋里朝它看。我从来不看。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-standing.opt.0.label: 我不关门。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-standing.text: 那我师父说对了。我替它守了三十年的钟。我害怕。你走的时候，门别关。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-what.opt.0.label: 那口钟做什么用？
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-what.text: 石头。夏天有海鸥。我师父说那上头不只是石头，敲了钟就知道。他敲过一回。他看见了什么，从没跟我讲过。
content.fx.the-bay.oc.ring-the-bell.2.narrate: 石柱上，那东西还立着。它没有沉回去。
content.npc.keeper.name: 奥斯温·马拉布尔
content.obj.the-bay.at-the-door.hint: 栈桥脚下，海港馆的门敞着。
content.obj.the-bay.at-the-door.title: 走到馆门口
content.obj.the-bay.hear-the-keeper.hint: 他站在馆里最里头，面朝门口。
content.obj.the-bay.hear-the-keeper.title: 和看守人说话
content.obj.the-bay.jetty-end.hint: 沿栈桥走到尽头的钟那里。
content.obj.the-bay.jetty-end.title: 走到栈桥尽头
content.obj.the-bay.ring-the-bell.title: 敲钟
content.obj.what-stood-up.tell-the-keeper.title: 告诉看守人
content.quest.the-bay.goal: 听看守人说完，走到栈桥尽头，敲响那口钟，看石柱上升起什么。
content.quest.what-stood-up.goal: 回到馆里，告诉看守人石柱上立起了什么。
content.world.boundary.message: 那边的海水太冷了。你折回栈桥。
content.world.outro: 身后的钟已经不晃了。石柱上，那东西还立在它升起的地方，一直没走。
content.world.title: 水那边的东西

source.class.traveller.blurb: You came down the coast road with the evening tide, carrying a lantern and nothing else.
source.class.traveller.name: Traveller
source.containers.decoration_notice: The hall's barrels stand empty, and have for years.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-after.opt.0.label: It is standing.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-after.text: I heard it. Don't tell me it was empty. Is it standing?
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-bell.opt.0.label: I will ring it.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-bell.text: It hangs at the end of the jetty. Ring it once and look at the stack. I have kept it thirty winters and never touched the rope. Walk out there, and come back and tell me.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.0.label: What is out there?
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.1.label: What is the bell for?
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.text: Evening. You came along the shore, so you will have seen the stack out in the bay. Don't look at it from in here. I don't.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-standing.opt.0.label: I'll leave it open.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-standing.text: Then my keeper was right, and I have kept a bell for it for thirty years. I'm frightened. Leave the door open when you go.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-what.opt.0.label: What is the bell for?
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-what.text: Rock. Gulls, in summer. My keeper said there was more than rock, and that the bell would show it. He rang it once. He never told me what he saw.
source.fx.the-bay.oc.ring-the-bell.2.narrate: Out on the stack, the thing is still standing. It has not gone back down.
source.npc.keeper.name: Oswin Marrable
source.obj.the-bay.at-the-door.hint: The hall's door stands open at the foot of the jetty.
source.obj.the-bay.at-the-door.title: Go to the hall door
source.obj.the-bay.hear-the-keeper.hint: He stands at the back of the hall, facing the door.
source.obj.the-bay.hear-the-keeper.title: Speak to the keeper
source.obj.the-bay.jetty-end.hint: Walk out to the bell at the end of the jetty.
source.obj.the-bay.jetty-end.title: Walk to the end of the jetty
source.obj.the-bay.ring-the-bell.hint: The bell stands at the very end of the jetty.
source.obj.the-bay.ring-the-bell.title: Ring the bell
source.obj.what-stood-up.tell-the-keeper.hint: The keeper is waiting in the hall.
source.obj.what-stood-up.tell-the-keeper.title: Tell the keeper
source.quest.the-bay.goal: Hear the keeper, walk to the end of the jetty, ring the bell and watch what rises on the stack.
source.quest.what-stood-up.goal: Go back into the hall and tell the keeper what stood up on the stack.
source.world.boundary.message: The water is too cold out there. You turn back to the jetty.
source.world.outro: Behind you the bell has stopped swinging. Out on the stack, the thing stands where it rose, and it is still there.
source.world.title: The Thing Across the Water
